sdc.daemon.EventKind.title: EventKind
sdc.daemon.EventKind.description: Open text: the kind of the runtime's run-log line, copied. Events the daemon writes itself have a kind that starts with `runbook.`, and the command that writes each one declares it: runbook.submitted (SubmitRun), runbook.cancel-requested (CancelRun), runbook.start-failed (FailRunStart), runbook.run-orphaned (EndOrphanedRun), runbook.answer-undeliverable (AnswerDecision) and runbook.runtime-failed (written by the daemon just before it issues EndRun with the outcome runtime-failure). Not a closed set for the runtime's own kinds.
